color.note: Reference values are VS Code's Dark Modern, Light Modern and Dark High Contrast defaults. In the extension every UI token is bound to the --vscode-* variable named in its usage note, so the user's real theme always wins; brand-* tokens are fixed and never paint UI chrome.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Webview page and table background. Binds --vscode-editor-background.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sticky table header, toolbar strip, log viewer gutter. Binds --vscode-sideBar-background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Drawers, cards, popovers. Binds --vscode-editorWidget-background.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and ghost-button hover. Binds --vscode-list-hoverBackground.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Text inputs, selects, search field. Binds --vscode-input-background.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected table row, active job in the tree. Binds --vscode-list-activeSelectionBackground.

tokens.name: selection-outline
tokens.usage: 1px outline on the selected row; carries selection in High Contrast where the fill is black. Binds --vscode-list-focusOutline.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Row dividers, drawer and card edges. Binds --vscode-panel-border.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, chips. Binds --vscode-input-border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and status labels on surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised, selection. Binds --vscode-foreground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text: paths, timestamps, sample windows, column headers, on surface and surface-sunken. Binds --vscode-descriptionForeground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (Trigger Workflow, Run Selected, Approve). One per region. Binds --vscode-button-background.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. Binds --vscode-button-hoverBackground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. Binds --vscode-button-foreground.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links: run #, commit SHA, Open on GitHub. Binds --vscode-textLink-foreground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 1px :focus-visible ring on every control and row; 3:1+ on every surface. Binds --vscode-focusBorder.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon only; the label beside it stays ink. Binds --vscode-testing-iconPassed.

tokens.name: failure
tokens.usage: Failure icon, failed-step marker, log error lines. Binds --vscode-errorForeground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting-for-approval and stale icons, preview banner icon. Icon only: light value is 3.1:1, below text contrast. Binds --vscode-editorWarning-foreground.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: In-progress icon and the active step in plans and trackers. Binds --vscode-charts-blue.

tokens.name: restricted
tokens.usage: Permission Restricted, SSO Required, Access Restricted icons. Binds --vscode-charts-purple.

tokens.name: uncertain
tokens.usage: Outcome Uncertain, Missed Schedule icons and dashed outlines. Binds --vscode-charts-orange.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Count badges (folder counts, pending approvals). Binds --vscode-badge-background.

tokens.name: badge-ink
tokens.usage: Text on badge. Binds --vscode-badge-foreground.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners (local vs remote preview, stale data). Ink text on it. Binds --vscode-inputValidation-warningBackground.

tokens.name: error-surface
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and failed log lines. Ink text on it. Binds --vscode-inputValidation-errorBackground.

tokens.name: info-surface
tokens.usage: Background of info banners (local scheduling notice). Ink text on it. Binds --vscode-inputValidation-infoBackground.

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: Identity only: logo, Marketplace banner, README hero. Never UI chrome, never a status.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Identity only: logo tile, Marketplace galleryBanner color (dark).

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Identity only: light card in the mark, docs backgrounds.

tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: Identity only: secondary shapes in the mark.

families.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe WPC", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Ubuntu, "Droid Sans", sans-serif
families.mono: "SF Mono", Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Droid Sans Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding and empty-repo hero only. Never inside the dashboard.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Uppercase section headers, as VS Code side-bar sections. Use sparingly.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default for rows, labels, form text. Binds --vscode-font-size.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Workflow names, folder rows, emphasized values.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under names, help text under fields.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Log viewer lines, YAML snippets. Binds --vscode-editor-font-family.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Refs, SHAs, input keys, durations in dense columns.

spacing.note: A 2px base with VS Code's own steps. Rows and toolbars are dense by default.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-chip inset, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Cell padding, gap between toolbar controls.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Drawer and card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields and between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, section breaks inside drawers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips: VS Code's control radius.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, drawers, banners, log viewer.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers and the dispatch tracker.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count badges and the countdown pill only.

size.note: Fixed layout dimensions. The narrow breakpoint is used in media queries as a literal 700px.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Workflow table rows and job-tree rows (dense default).

tokens.name: row-h-comfy
tokens.usage: Rows when the user turns on actionDeck.density = comfortable.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: toolbar-h
tokens.usage: Dashboard toolbar and drawer header strip.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Every status and action icon.

tokens.name: drawer-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the inspector or companion drawer before it stacks under the table.

tokens.name: bp-narrow
tokens.usage: Below this panel width two-column grids collapse to one.

tokens.name: shadow-widget
tokens.usage: Popovers and the floating batch bar only. Drawers use a border, not a shadow. Binds --vscode-widget-shadow.
